backend/main.mo: Actor implementing user profiles, resumes, learning plans, quizzes, interviews, and access‑controlled storage APIs using mixins and maps.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten list of short summaries for major frontend files describing their responsibilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, light/dark modes, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that loads the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/README.md: Frontend README outlining project purpose, prerequisites, and local development setup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router setup defining public and protected routes, authentication gating, and layout structure.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Layout shell with navigation, user profile display, sidebar, mobile drawer, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AsyncState.tsx: Wrapper component that displays loading, error, empty, or child content states.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Gates content behind Internet Identity auth and handles initial user profile setup.
frontend/src/components/Brand.tsx: Renders the VidyaMitra logo and branded text.
frontend/src/components/LoadingRocket.ts: Shows a bouncing rocket loading indicator with text.
frontend/src/components/NotFoundPage.tsx: Simple 404 page with a button to navigate home.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity loading via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React-query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, resumes, learning plan, quizzes, and progress.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining theme variables and utilities for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/routes.ts: Defines route metadata and splits public vs protected app routes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React Query and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisPage.tsx: Displays resume analysis with scores, strengths, gaps, and recommendations, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows user dashboard with stats, quick actions, and profile/resume/progress data loading handling.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSelectionPage.t: Allows users to search and select a career domain, updating state and navigating to job-role selection.
Evaluates resume-based eligibility for a selected job role with scoring, requirements, and conditional UI states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, feature highlights, and navigation based on authentication state.
frontend/src/pages/InterviewPage.tsx: Provides text or simulated voice interview answering with feedback submission and result display.
Provides job role search, selection, and custom role input, redirecting users to eligibility after choosing a role.
frontend/src/pages/LearningPlanPage.tsx: Loads or creates a 4‑week learning plan, displays weekly tasks with completion tracking, and handles errors and task completion updates.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login, redirects authenticated users to the dashboard, and shows a secure authentication UI.
frontend/src/pages/ProgressPage.tsx: Aggregates and displays user progress across tasks, quizzes, interviews, and learning plans with error handling and navigation options.
frontend/src/pages/QuizPage.tsx: Generates and runs a configurable quiz, tracks answers and score, saves results, and shows completion feedback with retry options.
frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx: Initiates Internet Identity registration, redirects authenticated users, and presents onboarding info about secure decentralized login.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeUploadPage.tsx: React page for uploading PDF/DOCX resumes with file validation, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/state/careerFlowStore.tsx: Context provider storing domain and job role selections with localStorage persistence and helper setters.
frontend/src/utils/quiz.ts: Static pool of quiz questions categorized by topic with correct answers using BigInt indices.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing VidyaMitra’s architecture, features, requirements, and development notes.
